rationale: Despite a positive earnings surprise, WIX is showing significant weakness, trading near its daily lows and well below the session VWAP of $68.28. While the stock is currently hovering just above the 9-EMA ($65.21), the high relative volume and the sharp gap-down suggest sustained selling pressure that makes a long position high-risk, while the proximity to the daily low ($64.00) makes a short position prone to a bounce or support-level exhaustion. Given the existing portfolio's heavy short bias, I am opting to remain neutral to avoid over-exposure to potential mean-reversion in a volatile, beaten-down stock.
